label: performanceLevelCode
comment: An optional list of performance levels (eg C, B, A, AA) defined by the scheme and used to assign criterion to the relevant performance level.

rangeIncludes.comment: A list of performance level codes that may be assigned to criterion. Conformity at a higher level requires conformity agaisnt all criteria at lower levels.

domainIncludes.comment: A conformity scheme as a structured hierarchy of conformity critera.# Note: the id" and "type" aliases need to be defined in the context of# the sample because UNTP uses these aliases throughout its models,# as they are defined in the VC context globally:# See https://github.com/w3c/vc-data-model/blob/949c8e1749a18dfd1e5d7556f9d5cb7801e0932f/contexts/credentials/v2#L5-L20# We could update untp-core to not use them, then we wouldn't need to define# them here either.
